messages:
alice: Quick sync — launch in 4 weeks. Need to lock a capacity contingency plan + SLO gate for hosted API. Can we agree on p95 latency target 300ms and a clear fallback policy if GPU pools saturate?
jia: Today our burst pool can absorb ~1.2x baseline qps for short periods. Error-budget burn is the bigger risk if we underprovision.
ben: From product side: launch acceptance = SLO met on 3/3 weekly windows, <3% error budget burn, documented fallback + runbook. If any of those fails -> roll to limited rollout.
sanjay: Proposed technical fallback: auto-route overflow to lower-cost quantized variant + apply circuit-breaker to slow callers. Downgrade path: redwood-alpha -> redwood-alpha-q8 -> redwood-mini-v1-q4. Should be automated.
emily: Enterprise customers asked for predictable tail behavior; they want a hard latency cutoff and prioritized reserved capacity option. We should include a checkbox in PRD for reserved-capacity signup flow.
jia: Canary thresholds suggestion: if p95 > 300ms for 3 consecutive 5-min windows OR error rate >= 4% in 10m -> enable spillover and reduce concurrency on new requests. Also throttle large batch requests.
sanjay: Edge cases we must test: token length surge (20k->50k), KV cache cold starts, multi-tenant noisy neighbor. Also verify token-cost accounting when routing to a different model.
ben: Acceptance criteria (concrete):
- unit smoke: 1000 req soak @ expected distribution, p95 < 300ms
- chaos: kill one gpu node in pool, <1% request loss via fallback
- billing: token accounting preserved across model downgrade
If all pass -> green.
jia: Quick config snippet for operator policy (for the runbook/devops):
```yaml
policy:
  fallback_model: "redwood-mini-v1-q4"
  max_spillover_qps: 200
  circuit_breaker:
    error_rate: 0.05
    window: 60s
  throttle:
    large_batch_threshold: 512
    reduce_concurrency: 0.5
```
sanjay: Implementation notes: autoscaler should expose a "spillover_mode" flag and we need metrics to track `spillover_qps` and `downgrade_count`. Instrument the model resolver to emit `routed_model_id` per request.
alice: Good. Let's negotiate SLO margin — product will accept p95 300ms if we commit to these tests + automated downgrade. Ops: @jia, can you produce a short runbook + playbook by EOD Friday?
jia: On it. I'll add exact PromQL alerts and runbook steps.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: hosted-api-v2 -> 20% traffic at 2026-03-25T02:00Z (canary_id: c-8451).
emily: Minor ask: add a customer-facing note for the reserved capacity feature and callout on performance guarantees in the console.
ben: Ok. Action items captured: runbook (jia), test matrix (sanjay), PRD update (ben + emily) — target sign-off by next Tue.
alice: Thanks. If anyone has objections to the downgrade path or thresholds ping here. Otherwise we'll fold into the PRD and SLO doc. :thumbsup:
